topics.description: The shooting at the White House Correspondents' Dinner has sparked a nationwide investigation and debate about gun control and security measures. The suspect, Cole Allen, has been identified and is being investigated by the FBI.

There have been several investigations into fraud in Minnesota, including a construction wage theft investigation and a investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar. These investigations have sparked concerns about corruption and accountability in the state.
topics.reason: Multiple investigations and allegations of corruption
